podcast.title: Co-writer of "Why Do Fools Fall in Love"
podcast.body: Jimmy Merchant helped Herman Santiago write "Why Do Fools Fall in Love" but was not credited on the song's original release. "Why the fools fall in love, was written by Herman Santiago, with the help of Jimmy Merchant."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 35: "Why Do Fools Fall In Love?" by Frankie Lymon and the Teenagers

podcast.title: Continued Performance
podcast.body: Jimmy Merchant continued to perform with Herman Santiago in various lineups of The Teenagers until his retirement a few years prior to the podcast's recording. "But Santiago and Merchant continued, often done, with a lineup of the Teenagers."

podcast.title: Legal Battle for Song Credit
podcast.body: In 1992, Merchant and Herman Santiago finally won legal credit for having written "Why Do Fools Fall in Love." However, this ruling was tragically overturned in 1996 because they were deemed to have waited too long to initiate legal action, causing the rights to revert to Frankie Lymon's estate and Morris Levy. "In 1992, Santiago and Merchant finally won the credit for having written Why the Fools Fall in Love, but in 1996 the ruling was overturned."
